As I told you in a personal message, I am working on a mechanism to let "trusted" users post without restrictions, but the mechanism which determines who is trusted and who is not - has to work on a per-subverse basis.

Up until yesterday, everyone was able to post everything, everywhere, simply if they had 100 CCP or LCP spread throughout different subverses. This was unsafe in the long run and opened whoaverse to a serious problem where a bot could be created to post thousands of spam comments or links using account of a "trusted user" (bot owner could comment a bit and then turn over its account to the bot).

This mechanism needs to be rewritten where "trusted user" status is calculated by fetching CCP or LCP for the subverse where this user intends to post the comment or message.

For example, if the user wants to submit to /v/news without any limitations, CCP or LCP count has to be over (say, 100) in /v/news. If the user has 100 LCP from /v/privatespamsub, he should be throttled when posting to /v/news until /v/news LCP reaches 100. This is how reddit works (as far as I know) and this is so far the best way to go about it.

I will implement this in a few days and post an announcement as soon as I am done.

Thank you for your patience.
